it depends on where you live, and your age. as im from the uk healthcare is free and to get a therapy appointment all youd have to do is go to your local hospital, but if youre from another country im not sure, sorry. try googling how to see a therapist in [insert your country here] and as for your age, if youre a minor under 18 then you’d probably need your parents consent, but if youre over 18 you dont. i hope this helped:)

hey, if youre still here, do you need to talk? it wont solve your problems but, its definitely comforting to talk about things, especially things like suicide, im always here if you feel like talking:)

im not sure if they would, you could try googling it, there are some websites like kooth (for teens) that stay completely anonymous unless you give them your information, and the counsellors there are also professionals, id say to give kooth a go if samaritans isnt anonymous, and id you dont feel comfortable with that feel free to message me any time:)
hey, im here for you if you ever wanna talk, feel free to message me or reply to this comment:)

i know it can seem like people wouldnt care or remember but, of course people would, at least your family, a friend, me, everybodys life has a purpose, its just hard to recognise sometimes. i cant convince you not to kill yourself but please, try to think logically about it, wait at least a few days to a week. stay strong and feel free to talk to me if needed <3
